rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the paper's central testable claim: three spin-wave modes of the kagome AFM with mutually orthogonal polarizations (x,y,z) at k=0, confirmed with orthogonality error 0.0 and purity 0.99-1.00. The resonance frequency ratio √(K₂/K₁) matches analytically to machine precision. Full k-resolved LSWT independently confirms the three-band structure including the known zero-energy flat band. Coverage is 7/10 because the spin-pumping transport chain (Eqs. 17-18, ISHE voltage) was verified structurally but not numerically integrated end-to-end, and the scattering-matrix derivation of Onsager coefficients was not independently checked.
